cohort: Preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks' gestation with a diagnosis of severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) and born to Black or White mothers, enrolled in the BPD Collaborative registry from January 2015 to July 2021.
finding: Infants born to Black mothers with severe BPD had an increased likelihood of death and increased length of hospital stay compared to infants born to White mothers.
gest_age: Less than 32 weeks, with a median of 25 weeks (IQR 24-27 weeks)
